title: Impact Investing Intern
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You are part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

We are now hiring interns for our **H****1** **202****7****cohort**! Internships will start in**January****202****7****.** Students who can commit full-time will be preferred.

Join us as a**Impact Investing Intern**to make an impact!

Location: **Kallang**

Kickstart your career in impact investing by supporting value creation initiatives that help portfolio companies grow. You'll work with founders, internal teams, and industry experts to drive meaningful outcomes and strengthen portfolio support capabilities.

**What will you do?**

Portfolio Needs Assessment and Value Creation Mapping

* Support the team in gathering, analysing, and summarising portfolio company priorities, pain points, and support requests across SEEAA’s value creation areas.
* Help map company needs against SEEAA’s value levers, including growth acceleration, capital and cash discipline, operational scalability, ESG and impact readiness, and talent and leadership.
* Prepare concise internal summaries, trackers, and briefing notes to support prioritisation of value creation opportunities.
* Contribute to portfolio support roadmaps with clear problem statements, expected outcomes, support owners, and next steps.

Project Coordination for Value Creation Initiatives

* Coordinate selected value creation projects, including masterclasses, expert clinics, mentorship sessions, technical assistance discussions, and portfolio support sprints.
* Support scheduling, agenda preparation, stakeholder follow-up, meeting notes, action tracking, and feedback collection across portfolio companies, internal experts, and external partners.
* Maintain and update the value creation tracker to improve visibility on project status, owners, milestones, risks, and outcomes.
* Build and maintain a structured database of relevant Schneider Electric experts, senior mentors, ecosystem partners, technical capabilities, and functional communities that can support portfolio companies.
* Identify internal and external resources that can be mobilised for specific portfolio needs, including workshops, mentorship, introductions, and targeted advisory support.

Process Improvement, Reporting, and Knowledge Management

* Support the development or refinement of templates, dashboards, internal playbooks, and AI-enabled tools to improve reporting, portfolio management, and value creation workflows.
* Collaborate with the global impact investing team to share process knowledge, databases, templates, and learnings, ensuring tools and workflows are practical, reusable, and scalable across funds and regions.
* Help organise value creation knowledge materials, including case studies, support examples, founder feedback, project learnings, and portfolio needs analysis.
* Assist in preparing slide decks, briefs, and communication materials for internal stakeholders, portfolio companies, and ecosystem partners.
* Provide general ad-hoc support to the impact investing team on emerging projects and team priorities, such as preparation of annual reports, impact reports, internal updates, portfolio reviews, and other strategic or operational initiatives as they arise.

Portfolio Engagement and Ecosystem Activities

* Support engagement activities such as portfolio events, founder roundtables, hackathons, expert clinics, and networking opportunities that connect startups with Schneider Electric’s ecosystem.
* Help prepare founder-facing materials, event agendas, survey forms, feedback summaries, and follow-up notes.
* Track potential collaboration opportunities, ecosystem introductions, and follow-on support actions arising from portfolio engagement activities.

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

* Currently pursuing a degree in business, finance, economics, sustainability, engineering, public policy, entrepreneurship, or a related field.
* Strong interest in impact investing, climate tech, clean energy, entrepreneurship, emerging markets, and startup growth.
* Structured thinker with strong analytical, writing, and synthesis skills; able to turn fragmented inputs into clear summaries and actionable next steps.
* Good project coordination skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple workstreams with different stakeholders.
* Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools, especially PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with collaboration, automation, or AI tools is a plus.
* Self-starter with a collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to engage with founders, experts, and internal teams across different markets.

(External) English Qualifications:

**What's in it for me?**

* Real-world experience supporting projects that directly impact business outcomes
* Mentorship from leaders who are invested in helping you grow and succeed
* Exposure to strategic planning, cross-functional collaboration, and operational processes
* A welcoming culture that encourages questions, learning, and professional development
* A strong foundation to launch your career in General Management

Ready to gain experience that matters? Join us and take the first step toward an exciting career!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

description:
**[What the role is]**

The Sustainability Division (SD) plans, strategises, and develops initiatives to drive resource conservation and environmental sustainability across the public, private, and people sectors to contribute to Singapore’s efforts in mitigating climate change and moving towards a zero-waste nation. It develops and promotes programmes, coordinates and administers incentive schemes, and builds capability to support this drive. It also coordinates efforts within NEA for the organisation and its staff to play its own part in the nationwide effort.

**[What you will be working on]**

Specifically, you will be part of the dynamic Households Branch under the Department of Sustainable Packaging Policy and Household Programmes in SD. You will support the administration of the enhanced Climate Friendly Households Programme, working closely with participating retailers and internal stakeholders to ensure the programme is implemented smoothly. This includes managing product whitelisting and approval workflows, supporting retailer onboarding, and handling data analysis to support programme audit and compliance checks. You will also coordinate programme implementation tasks such as printed voucher requests with internal teams.

This role involves working with a range of tools — including Microsoft Office, Robotic Process Automation, and various government applications - to manage administrative processes efficiently.

**[What we are looking for]**

* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable working with data
* Tech-savvy, with an ability to pick up new tools and systems quickly
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for detail
* Good written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder engagement
* Able to work independently and manage multiple tasks concurrently
* Good team player, resourceful and adaptable
* 1–3 years of relevant experience is preferred. Fresh diploma graduates with a keen interest will also be considered.

description:
Job Category: Administration

Posting Date: 31 Jul 2026

Join SingHealth's Office for Sustainable Health (OSH) and play a pivotal role in shaping how Singapore's largest public healthcare cluster measures, reports, and advances its sustainability commitments. You will work at the intersection of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) strategy, data governance, and stakeholder engagement — contributing directly to the national ESG reporting framework for Singapore's public healthcare sector.

We are seeking a Senior Assistant Director to lead the development of robust ESG data reporting systems and internal controls, and to prepare disclosures that meet global standards whilst aligning with national frameworks. Reporting to the Group Director of OSH, with matrix reporting to the Deputy Group Chief Financial Officer, you will work closely with Finance and Risk Management teams as well as institutional partners across SingHealth to ensure that sustainability data is accurate, meaningful, and audit-ready.

**What You Will Do:**

You will develop and implement a cluster-wide sustainability data collection system and internal controls framework, with the goal of establishing a validated, audit-ready baseline and enabling prospective tracking across all SingHealth institutions

Working in close collaboration with the Finance and Risk Management teams, you will integrate financial and social metrics into ESG disclosures, ensuring consistency and alignment between SingHealth's Financial Report and its ESG report as part of the Ministry of Health (MOH)-led collective reporting for the public healthcare sector. You will coordinate with all SingHealth institutions to meet MOH-mandated milestones for data submission, managing timelines and escalating critical decisions to senior leadership where appropriate.

You will regularly review and assess sustainability-related risks and opportunities, working with internal stakeholders to support prioritisation of action plans and track material ESG topics that align with SingHealth's mission, strategic goals, and commitments to the communities it serves. Insights drawn from tracked data will be shared in a timely manner to support care improvement and strategic transformation across the cluster.

Supporting the SingHealth governance framework for sustainability, you will ensure transparency and accuracy in outcome reporting. You will also supervise one direct report to provide guidance and direction as the team's work matures.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Sustainability Management, or related fields
* An accounting background with professional accounting certification such as Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or equivalent is preferred
* At least 12 years of relevant work experience, with prior experience in the healthcare sector or in healthcare or environmental regulatory agencies being an advantage
* Demonstrated experience in financial reporting, internal controls, or sustainability reporting with a focus on risk management or integrated reporting
* Experience in implementing digital tools or software solutions for data automation in a reporting or analytics context, including working knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI is preferred.
* Team player with strong collaboration skills and ability to work independently
* A genuine passion for environmental sustainability and a commitment to driving meaningful, positive change
